description: This file defines a REST API resource class for internal loan information endpoints, including audit data retrieval and advanced payment rules, used for internal testing within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: InternalLoanInformationApiResource
classes.description: A Spring component providing internal REST API endpoints for loan audit data, transaction audit data, loan filtering by status, and advanced payment rules, primarily used for testing purposes.

methods.name: getLoanAuditFields
methods.description: Fetches audit metadata (created/modified by and date) for a specific loan.

methods.name: getLoanTransactionAuditFields
methods.description: Retrieves audit metadata for a specific loan transaction.

methods.name: getLoansByStatus
methods.description: Returns a list of loan IDs filtered by a specific status ID.

methods.name: getAdvancedPaymentAllocationRulesOfLoan
methods.description: Retrieves advanced payment allocation rules associated with a particular loan.
